unified_customer_form.data_collection_approach: Single comprehensive form with jurisdiction-specific sections
validation_rules: All personal information fields are mandatory
Government ID must be valid and not expired
Financial information must be consistent and verifiable
Investment profile must be complete for suitability assessment
Compliance screening must clear all jurisdictional requirements
Jurisdiction-specific fields mandatory based on account types requested

data_mapping_strategy.approach: Collect once, map to multiple jurisdictions

data_storage.master_record: Single customer master record with all data
data_storage.jurisdiction_views: Filtered views for each jurisdiction's compliance team
data_storage.audit_trail: Complete audit trail for all data access and modifications

data_governance: Data privacy compliance (GDPR for EU clients)

implementation_approach: Phase 1: Design unified customer data model
Phase 2: Implement single data collection interface
Phase 3: Create jurisdiction-specific data views and workflows
Phase 4: Integrate with existing compliance systems
Phase 5: Test with pilot customers across all jurisdictions
Phase 6: Full rollout with comprehensive staff training

checks: Verify compliance with US disclosure requirements
Verify compliance with EU disclosure requirements
Verify compliance with UK disclosure requirements
